Site Reliability Engineer

Austin, TX · Hybrid Full-time Infrastructure

About Veridian

Veridian Networks operates a global content-delivery network serving 18 of the top 100 websites by traffic. Our edge platform spans 360 PoPs across 95 countries and handles over 600 million HTTPS requests per second at peak.

About the role

We're hiring a Site Reliability Engineer to join our Edge Platform team. You'll own the reliability of services that route traffic across our 360-PoP network and contribute to our chaos-engineering practice.

You will

  • Operate and improve the global routing layer (Anycast BGP, GeoDNS)
  • Drive incident response, root-cause analysis, and post-incident reviews
  • Build automation and tooling in Go and Python to reduce toil
  • Improve our observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, custom tracing)
  • Run chaos-engineering exercises and reliability game-days
  • Participate in primary on-call rotation (1 week per 6)

You have

  • 4+ years of SRE or production-engineering experience
  • Strong Linux fundamentals and networking (TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, HTTP/2/3)
  • Experience with at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes operations at scale
  • Production coding experience in Go and/or Python
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi)
  • Comfort with on-call and incident-response work

Bonus

  • Experience with BGP, Anycast routing, or CDN operations
  • eBPF, XDP, or kernel networking
  • Public talks or technical writing on reliability topics
  • Open-source contributions to observability or networking projects

Compensation

$155,000 - $200,000 base, plus equity in a profitable, late-stage company. Comprehensive benefits, $3,000 annual learning stipend, and 4 weeks paid vacation minimum.

Veridian Networks is an equal-opportunity employer. We are unable to sponsor visas at this time.
